summary.text: Manoj Chourasia is a Democratic state representative from New Hampshire House District Hillsborough 11 who has served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives since 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is an information technology professional.

paragraphs.text: Manoj Chourasia's career experience includes working in information technology, according to Ballotpedia.
Ballotpedia says he has been affiliated with the India Association of New Hampshire.
He first took office representing Hillsborough 11 on December 4, 2024.
